note: Corrections are used only when the primary Telegram history is missing one side of an alert pair and the missing timestamp is directly reported by a corroborating source. They are not inferred or interpolated.

corrections.evidence_note: Razvozhaev MAX mirror reports the Sevastopol air alert at 14:58 and the all-clear at 15:26 local time on 2026-09-16; a second outlet independently reports that the alert lasted less than half an hour. The Telegram start timestamp is retained at second precision; the reported end is minute precision.
